transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Last spring I was telling someone about that rail hop I did from Beijing down to Shanghai—super smooth ride, way less stressful than flying.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And on a totally different trip, I spent a few days in Nanjing—mostly just wandering around and eating everything in sight.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: When I was in Shanghai, I remember chatting about what to see there—everyone had opinions, but the city basically sells itself.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: That same Shanghai visit, my friends kept talking up the local shows too—like there was always something on at night.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For that Beijing-to-Shanghai run, the ticket was already set as train D321 on 2025-03-23, under Zhao Min, and it was Second Class—nothing fancy but totally fine.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My coworker also told me about their Nanjing stay: it was Sofitel Nanjing Galaxy, checking in 2025-04-25 for 4 nights, and the booking name was Aiden Miller.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Oh—and Emily Wang had already gotten her ticket to the Oriental Pearl Tower for 2025-03-16 in the afternoon, just 1 ticket, so she went up solo and sent pics.

intent.ambiguity_notes: Negative intent throughout: user is reminiscing about past trips and third-party bookings in 2025; no request for help or action.
